headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when AEW welcomed The Opps (Bowens, Hook & Shibata) for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.15.
2025 brought us this moment: King & Templario kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.34.

On a Saturday in 2026, back when Kevin Knight vs. Dezmond Xavier clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.77. It was the first title opportunity of Dezmond Xavier's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Kyle O'Reilly closed out Collision, rated 7.70 ? a solid showing in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On a Friday in 2025, back when Adam Cole vs. Josh Alexander clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.12. For Josh Alexander, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
On this day in 2026, it marked the first-ever meeting between Athena & Mone and Hyan & World, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.81 ? a solid showing.
